name: Jelly Roll Style Meat Loaf
description: A creative meat loaf recipe shaped like a jelly roll, filled with mozzarella cheese and baked in a loaf pan.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup cracker crumbs or dry bread crumbs

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients except ground beef in a large bowl, using only 1 cup of mozzarella cheese.
Add ground beef and mix thoroughly with hands until just combined.
Shape the mixture into a 10x12 inch rectangle on waxed paper.
Sprinkle 2 cups of mozzarella cheese over the meat.
Roll up the mixture like a jelly roll using the waxed paper and press ends together to seal.
Place the foil-wrapped jelly roll in a meat loaf pan and bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour.
Drain off fat and pour reserved tomato sauce on the roll.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before slicing.
Decorate with tomato slices and green parsley on a serving tray.

keywords: meat loaf, jelly roll, mozzarella cheese, baked

_similar.name: Delicious Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A classic meatloaf with a cheddar cheese and carrot mixture, topped with a sweet ketchup-mustard glaze.

recipeInstructions.text: Beat eggs in a bowl with a fork, then add milk, salt, pepper, and crumbled bread. Beat until the bread disintegrates.
Add chopped onion, shredded carrot, cheddar cheese, and ground beef to the bowl. Mix well.
Pack the mixture into a loaf pan.
Combine brown sugar, ketchup, and prepared mustard in a small bowl. Spread this glaze over the meatloaf.
Bake at 350°F for approximately 1½ hours.

_similar.keywords: meatloaf, cheddar cheese, ketchup glaze, classic American

_similar.name: Cheeseburger Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A cheeseburger-inspired meatloaf with a cheddar cheese and pickle relish filling, topped with tomato sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: In a mixing bowl, combine ground beef, egg, bread crumbs, garlic salt, onion powder, salt, pepper, and seasoning salt. Mix well.
Mix chopped onion and tomato sauce together in a separate bowl.
Add half of the tomato sauce and onion mixture to the beef mixture and mix well.
Pack half of the beef mixture into a loaf pan.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese and sweet pickle relish evenly over the top.
Pack the remaining beef mixture on top and press firmly.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350°F for 1 hour.
Carefully spoon off excess fat from the top.
Pour the remaining tomato sauce and onion mixture over the meatloaf.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let stand for about 5 minutes before inverting onto a heated serving platter if desired.

_similar.keywords: cheeseburger meatloaf, stuffed meatloaf, cheddar and pickle filling

_similar.name: Pizza Meatball
recipeIngredient: 12 oz frozen meatballs, thawed and cut in half

recipeInstructions.text: Place pizza crust in a pizza pan or on a baking sheet.
Sprinkle 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese over the crust.
Place meatballs on top of the cheese, cut side down.
Spread remaining pizza sauce over the meatballs.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese and Italian seasoning.
Bake in a 400°F oven for approximately 20 minutes, or until cheese is melted.
Cut into pizza wheels and serve.

_similar.name: Meat Balls and Sour And Sweet Sauce
_similar.description: A classic meatball recipe served in a tangy sweet and sour sauce, perfect for serving over meatballs, chicken, or pork chops.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp onion flakes or 1 tsp real onion

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together and form into 1½ inch balls.
Bake in an ungreased oblong pan for 20 to 25 minutes at 400°F.
Remove from oven and drain grease.
Place meatballs in a large casserole.
Pour sweet and sour sauce over the top and return to oven for 10 minutes or until hot.
To make the sauce, mix all ingredients together in a saucepan and stir while bringing to a boil until thickened.

_similar.keywords: meatballs, sweet and sour sauce, baked meatballs
